description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli proudly celebrated the Charter Ceremony of the Interact Club of St. Lawrence High School, marking another significant milestone in promoting youth leadership and the spirit of service.
61 Young Leaders Pinned! Vedant Nikam was ceremoniously collared as the Charter President, following which he shared his willingness to work in various avenues & proudly introduced his Board of Directors and team. Principal Mr. Shashishekhar Chauhan addressed the gathering, sharing his thoughts and encouragement for the newly formed Interact Club.
🌟 Chief Guest Rtn. CA Laxman K. Prasad, President of RCBK, delivered an inspiring speech on leadership, motivating the young Interactors to lead with confidence, responsibility and a commitment to service.
The ceremony marked the beginning of an exciting journey for our young Interactors, encouraging them to embrace Rotary's values of Leadership, Fellowship and Service Above Self.
